name: visual-stack-review
description: Document production stack analyser — detects the current renderer from PDF metadata, package.json, and HTML source signals, classifies the document type, and recommends whether to stay-and-fix or migrate. Handles three modes: render+source review, source-only pre-render advisory, and prospective intake. Always includes a stay+fix assessment; full migration comparison on request. Produces top 2-4 recommendations with 5-component effort breakdowns (source rewrite, layout-engine retuning, pipeline, ecosystem regression risk, author retraining) and plain-language summaries. Includes deep-dive references for Paged.js, WeasyPrint, Prince, Typst, headless Chrome, Playwright/Puppeteer, LaTeX, Pandoc, React-PDF/ReportLab, InDesign/Affinity, and wkhtmltopdf. Quarterly matrix review procedure included.
